v-autocomplete/items.description: Can be an array of objects or array of strings. When using objects, will look for a text, value and disabled keys. This can be changed using the **item-text**, **item-value** and **item-disabled** props.  Objects that have a **header** or **divider** property are considered special cases and generate a list header or divider; these items are not selectable.

v-autocomplete/menu-props.description: Pass props through to the `v-menu` component. Accepts either a string for boolean props `menu-props="auto, overflowY"`, or an object `:menu-props="{ auto: true, overflowY: true }"`

v-autocomplete/value-comparator.description: The comparison algorithm used for values. [More info](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/blob/v2-stable/packages/vuetify/src/util/helpers.ts)

v-breadcrumbs/items.description: An array of objects for each breadcrumb.

v-data-iterator/expanded.description: Array of expanded items. Can be used with `.sync` modifier

v-data-iterator/footer-props.description: See the [`v-data-footer`](/api/v-data-footer) API for more information

v-data-iterator/group-by.description: Changes which item property should be used for grouping items. Currently only supports a single grouping in the format: `group` or `['group']`. When using an array, only the first element is considered. Can be used with `.sync` modifier

v-data-iterator/group-desc.description: Changes which direction grouping is done. Can be used with `.sync` modifier

v-data-iterator/item-key.description: The property on each item that is used as a unique key

v-data-iterator/items.description: The array of items to display

v-data-iterator/items-per-page.description: Changes how many items per page should be visible. Can be used with `.sync` modifier. Setting this prop to `-1` will display all items on the page

v-data-iterator/loading.description: If `true` and no items are provided, then a loading text will be shown

v-data-iterator/loading-text.description: Text shown when `loading` is true and no items are provided

v-data-iterator/locale.description: Sets the locale used for sorting. This is passed into [`Intl.Collator()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/Collator/Collator) in the default `customSort` function

v-data-iterator/multi-sort.description: If `true` then one can sort on multiple properties

v-data-iterator/must-sort.description: If `true` then one can not disable sorting, it will always switch between ascending and descending

v-data-iterator/no-data-text.description: Text shown when no items are provided to the component

v-data-iterator/no-results-text.description: Text shown when `search` prop is used and there are no results

v-data-iterator/search.description: Text input used to filter items

v-data-iterator/server-items-length.description: Used only when data is provided by a server. Should be set to the total amount of items available on server so that pagination works correctly

v-data-iterator/single-expand.description: Changes expansion mode to single expand

v-data-iterator/single-select.description: Changes selection mode to single select

v-data-iterator/sort-desc.description: Changes which direction sorting is done. Can be used with `.sync` modifier

v-skeleton-loader/type.description: A string delimited list of skeleton components to create such as `type="text@3"` or `type="card, list-item"`. Will recursively generate a corresponding skeleton from the provided string. Also supports short-hand for multiple elements such as **article@3** and **paragraph@2** which will generate 3 _article_ skeletons and 2 _paragraph_ skeletons. Please see below for a list of available pre-defined options.
